transcript.user: The shopkeeper I complained about came to my house with 3 men and threatened to beat me if I go to consumer court. I'm scared.
transcript.assistant:
Please stay safe. If you are in immediate danger or feel unsafe right now, please call **112** immediately to get emergency help.

Threatening you with physical violence is a serious criminal matter. My scope is strictly limited to consumer dispute problems, so I cannot help with criminal threats or safety issues. 

Please consider filing a complaint with your local police station right away regarding this threat. You may also consult a lawyer, or reach out to your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) to see if you can get free legal aid [KB:LEGAL-AID].

Please note: This is general information, not a lawyer's advice.
